history.new: Of the 1632 relations, 833 are instances of the containment theorem (Kurth 1987 + Guibas-Odlyzko) and 787 have no common border (published c = 1 case, see CLM-C01-09); only 12 (one common border each) fall in the unpublished case (CLM-C01-10). The method (finite completion, automaton of normal words, rational series) is Ufnarovski's framework (Encycl. Math. Sci. 57, 1995).

proof_check: computer-assisted (Python) - independently re-verified convergent completion, Aho-Corasick automaton, recurrence-order bound s+k; brute-force cross-check n <= 8; not Lean-checked
statement:
For each of the 1632 relations marked PROVEN in results/EXP-C01-07.json (binary k <= 6, ternary k <= 4),
the class-count generating function equals c(x)/(x^k + (1 - q x) c(x)), c the common-border polynomial.
title: Common-border formula proved for 1632 specific relations by verified finite completions
